intended use: TERRAIN_LAYERS "Dirt" (packed earth paths).

notes: Normal maps are OpenGL convention (+Y up); for Unreal flip the green channel (or tick "Flip Green Channel"). ARM maps pack R=ambient occlusion, G=roughness, B=metallic (import as linear / sRGB off). Roughness/AO/Displacement are linear data. Attribution is not required by CC0; credit kept voluntarily.
